original_test_intent: Run the exact RVS PEBB single configuration on the approved GPU platform and verify all declared results comply with the AMD GPU specification.
original_method: Build immutable compatible ROCm/RVS, review/hash `pebb_single.conf`, enumerate its expected actions/targets/metrics, execute exact debug-3 command once under independent watchdog and health telemetry, then compare the complete roster to engineer-approved model limits.
manual_activity: RVS/GPU owner approves the pinned PEBB config semantics, actions and metric limits, authorizes safety and sets verdict.
required_inputs: PEBB action/target/metric roster and model limits
Thermal/power/time/error abort, OOB recovery and cleanup plan
safety_requirements: Preflight exact stable GPU targets and cooling/power/OOB
Abort/recover on threshold, hang, reset or unexpected action
agent_execution_scope: Capture all action/metric and platform health evidence
Report without inventing PEBB meaning, altering limits or deciding verdict
engineer_actions: Approve config-derived PEBB scope and limits
Review all results and decide outcome

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind binary/config hashes, stable targets and expected actions in one manifest, then reconcile every PEBB output and health record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the broad GPU-spec criterion traceable without assuming undocumented PEBB semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No PEQT/PESM/other module or generic RVS pass substitutes for pebb_single.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Metric names and thresholds are revision/config dependent and must be approved.

project_override_considerations: Engineering owns the authoritative PEBB action/metric interpretation for the pinned RVS revision and target GPU model.
expected_evidence: PEBB config hash/content plus expected action/target/metric manifest

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master clearly specifies pebb_single; DeepSeek's generic path is incomplete execution advice.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Artifacts, config semantics, limits and safety approval can be supplied.

review_improvement: Creates config-derived, revision-specific PEBB coverage and preserves the adjacent baseline without recounting it.
independent_technical_reasoning: The name PEBB alone does not prove which subactions or metrics a particular RVS revision runs. A successful generic command could silently exercise a different scope. The reviewed pebb_single config must therefore generate an expected action manifest, and missing or extra outputs must be explicit before any AMD-spec comparison is meaningful.
